svg.aria-label: Map of St Joseph of Cupertino's places and churches, numbered: 1 Copertino, with the Santuario di San Giuseppe built over the stable where he was born, the castle, and the sanctuary of Santa Maria della Grottella where he lived and flew; 2 Naples, where the Inquisition examined him in 1638; 3 Rome, with St Peter's and the friary of Santi Apostoli, where he rose in ecstasy before Pope Urban VIII; 4 Assisi, the Basilica of St Francis and the Sacro Convento, his home from 1639 to 1653; 5 Pietrarubbia and 6 Fossombrone, the Capuchin friaries where he was hidden from 1653 to 1657; 7 Osimo, where he died in 1663 and lies in the Basilica of San Giuseppe da Copertino. A dashed line traces his journeys under obedience; Martina Franca, Nardò, Altamura, Monopoli and Loreto are also marked. Insets show Copertino, Rome, Assisi and Osimo in close-up.
